### The Fear That Draws Us In
Author: John Piper
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/solid-joys/the-fear-that-draws-us-in
Passage: Exodus 20:20
Points:
- Scripture contrasts a slavish dread that pushes people away from God with a reverent fear that draws them close.
- Moses simultaneously told the Israelites not to be afraid and instructed them to keep God's fear before them to avoid sin.
- God reveals His power and majesty to lead believers to run toward Him rather than fleeing from Him.
- Fearing the Lord rightly means dreading the prospect of turning away from Him as one's security and joy.
- The real danger believers must fear is unbelief and pride rather than drawing near to God.

### 5 Questions to Ask if That ‘Open Door’ Looks Uncertain
Author: Cindi McMenamin
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/faith/women/5-questions-to-ask-if-that-open-door-looks-uncertain.html
Passage: Exodus 20:21
Points:
- Uncertainty and intimidation frequently tempt believers to remain at a safe distance from God's leading.
- While the Israelites stayed far off in fear, Moses had the courage to approach the thick darkness where God was.
- Experiencing the fullness of God's presence and glory often requires leaving familiar comfort zones.
- Following God into unknown circumstances stretches spiritual faith muscles and deepens reliance on Him.
- Believers can move forward through scary open doors knowing God will be present with them in the darkness.
